verdict.headline: CoreWeave posts $104B backlog as small caps rotate ahead of Wednesday's CPI gate
verdict.label: CRWV +13% AH on clean Q2 beat; Russell +0.32% while S&P shed 0.38%; oil triggers still active; 10Y 4.73%, 30Y ~5.22%; CPI 8:30 AM ET Wednesday
verdict.rationale_short: CoreWeave cleared all three morning criteria: backlog hit $104B (above the $100B clean threshold), Meta ($21B), Anthropic and Jane Street ($6B) diversified the customer base away from MSFT concentration risk, and the stock surged ~13% AH toward $100-101. The day session split sharply: Russell 2000 +0.32% while S&P 500 fell 0.38% — a 70bps divergence consistent with rate-sensitivity buyers pre-positioning for a soft CPI. Oil did not retreat: WTI held ~$82 and Brent $88.23, both above their triggers for a fifth consecutive session. September hike odds held at ~50% CME. July CPI arrives Wednesday 8:30 AM ET; Kalshi now prices less than 55% chance above 3.3%, skewing the market consensus toward ambiguous-to-soft. If SPX closes below 7,600 within two sessions of tomorrow's print, the record-proximity bid breaks.

trade_setups.asset: July CPI — Wednesday August 12, 8:30 AM ET
trade_setups.thesis: CPI arrives with CRWV's $104B backlog as the AI-demand anchor and 3-of-6 regime indicators still active (30Y ~5.22%, WTI $82, Brent $88). July embeds Brent at $82-91/bbl from the June-July peak; the current $88.23 is a floor for the comp. Kalshi pricing less than 55% chance above 3.3% signals the market consensus leans toward ambiguous-to-soft. The Russell's +0.32% outperformance Tuesday is a positioning vote, not a data read. Below 2.9%/3.2%: 30Y compresses, oil treated transient, CRWV AH and NVDA read-through compound. Above 3.2%/3.5%: supply-shock thesis confirmed with labor already negative; 30Y to 5.30%+; CRWV AH gains partially unwound.
trade_setups.entry: Ambiguous-to-soft skew. Watch 30Y direction in the first 30 minutes post-print: below 5.10% is the first de-escalation signal; above 5.30% is the entrenchment signal.
trade_setups.invalidation: Soft print (below 2.9%/3.2%) resets September odds to below 25% and removes rate hike as near-term narrative.
trade_setups.horizon: Wednesday 8:30 AM ET; secondary read Thursday and Friday.

trade_setups.thesis: Tuesday's 70bps spread (Russell +0.32%, SPX -0.38%) is a pre-CPI rate-sensitivity bet: small-cap buyers positioned for a soft print before the data. If CPI is at or below 3.3% (the Kalshi pivot), the rotation extends and AMD's $484 floor test resolves upward. If CPI surprises above 3.2%/3.5%, the rate-sensitive trade that benefited Tuesday unwinds first — Russell and AMD are the highest-beta downside exposure in this setup.
trade_setups.entry: Russell at 3,027; AMD at $484 floor. Thesis confirms on soft CPI; reverses on hot CPI.
trade_setups.invalidation: CPI above 3.2%/3.5% unwinds the rotation; Russell retraces toward 2,960-2,980.
trade_setups.horizon: Wednesday 8:30 AM ET through Friday close.

trade_setups.asset: NVDA — CRWV read-through into August 26 earnings
trade_setups.thesis: CRWV's $104B backlog with Anthropic hosting agreement is the best available pre-print evidence for NVDA's Blackwell demand cycle. The morning's scenario — 'clean print reprices NVDA Blackwell demand' — materialized. NVDA pre-market Wednesday is the primary read-through. If CPI is also soft, the two catalysts compound against $216 support. If CPI is hot, $216 is the structural test; the CRWV positive does not insulate against simultaneous rate and oil pressure.
trade_setups.entry: NVDA ~$217 regular close. $216 structural support. $221+ resistance. August 26 print is the terminal catalyst.
trade_setups.invalidation: Hot CPI AND 30Y above 5.30% AND NVDA AH fails to hold $216 simultaneously — three conditions required.
trade_setups.horizon: Wednesday pre-market through August 26 Q2 FY27.

bear_case: The CRWV positive resolves the AI-demand binary but leaves three macro conditions active. Oil at $82 and $88.23 is structurally embedded in Iran's Zolghadr framework — a post-war settlement precondition the Oman channel cannot satisfy in the CPI window. The 30Y at ~5.22% has been above 5.00% for eleven sessions; if CPI confirms the supply-shock channel (above 3.2%/3.5%), the next reference level is 5.30%, not 5.00%. The Russell's Tuesday outperformance is a bet, not a data read: if CPI is hot, the rate-sensitive names that rallied (small caps, AMD) experience the sharpest reversal. CRWV's AH gain (+13%) prices a sustained AI infrastructure demand cycle on $12.4-13.2B guidance backed by $35-39B annual capex — a 3x capex-to-revenue ratio that depends on continuous hyperscaler commitment at current rates. The level that changes the equity-resilience read: SPX closes below 7,600 within two sessions of tomorrow's print.
